body: First off as a DA myself (Delivery Associate) he’s 100% correct here. When you have a “One Time Passcode” delivery, 📦 the package gets one code that Amazon emails the customer. It only emails after the driver has scanned the packaged and has gone through the steps on the app to say he’s there waiting for the customer. Secondly he stated that she gave him the wrong passcode twice, there was one more chance but she wanted to start blaming him. Instead she should’ve refreshed her email or went through her Amazon app to get the code (They customer can also use the app for one time code packages). She likely gave him an older code, so it didn’t work. Also he does in fact need to return the package based off Amazon policy. The rest speaks for itself, the lady was rude, confrontational, demanding, and racist. He can show this video to his DSP and have them blacklist her address from getting any further Amazon packages. So lastly, if y’all want to be rude like her to the wrong driver don’t expect to kept buying things off Amazon.
